summary: Smoke verification of iteration 8 polish (Stone & Fire theme final polish). App loads at preview URL with no compile overlay. Homepage /Sıralama shows Cinzel amber section titles (Genel İstatistikler, Etkinlik Filtresi, Podyum, Tam Sıralama) all with fontFamily='Cinzel, Rajdhani, serif' and color rgb(212,115,10). Podium renders 3 slabs (Czar R4 10k, Ekko R5 11k, Ecyu R4 5k). After adding sample points to 4 more members, TAM SIRALAMA rendered 4 .rank-row items (#4-#7): position number '#4' in amber Cinzel (rgb(212,115,10)), member name 'HANA' in white Cinzel (rgb(245,240,232)), point total '3.500' in lava orange rgb(231,76,26)=#E74C1A. Admin login (admin/admin123) succeeded, token stored, must-change-password prompt shown. After login, bottom nav shows 6 runic-SVG buttons (Leaderboard, Commanders, Points List, Add Points, Members, Events) with active button showing lava glow (visible in screenshot). /uyeler alliance headers render in Cinzel bold 700 with letterSpacing 1.28px, correct case preserved: 'GOW', 'GoW', 'Gruplandırılmamış'. Language switcher TR→EN successfully updates all sidebar labels on /komutanlar: KOMUTANLAR→COMMANDERS, BİLGİLENDİRME→INFORMATION, Tetikçi→Marksman, Bombacı→Infantry, Kalkanlı→Lancer, KAFES ETKİNLİK→CAGE EVENT, GARNİZON→GARRISON, SAVAŞ→BATTLE, SVS EKİP→SVS TEAM. Backend POST /api/members with just {name:'x'} returned 200 with default null fields. All 8 requested checks pass.
